voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Between nineteen eighty-six and nineteen ninety-one, ten women were killed in a farming district south of Seoul.
Ten women. Five years. One killer.
beats.cap:
TEN WOMEN
FIVE YEARS
ONE KILLER

beats.vo: By two thousand and six, the statute of limitations had expired. The killer could not be charged.
beats.cap:
THE LAW'S OWN CLOCK
RAN OUT

beats.vo: In September two thousand nineteen, a DNA match. The real killer confessed to fourteen.
An innocent man, who had served twenty years on a forced confession, was finally acquitted.
